subject.title: feat(workboard): review gate hard blocks + workboard_submit_review tool

question: Should Workboard adopt a durable `ready_to_merge` status plus fail-closed `workboard_complete` review enforcement, or should review approval stay on the existing `review` status and proof metadata paths?
rationale: The PR changes stored Workboard state and existing completion behavior, so even after mechanical fixes it needs owner acceptance of the lifecycle and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Adopt after repair and proof
options.body: Accept the review-gate direction only after the patch fixes the gate, response envelope, metadata/UI consumers, tests, and contributor real behavior proof.

options.title: Avoid the new durable status
options.body: Keep the lifecycle on existing statuses and proof metadata if `ready_to_merge` is not intended as stored Workboard state.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Leave the PR open or close it if maintainers want a broader Workboard lifecycle design before adding hard review enforcement.

recommendation.title: Adopt after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Accept the review-gate direction only after the patch fixes the gate, response envelope, metadata/UI consumers, tests, and contributor real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the Workboard tool, manifest, status, docs, and UI surfaces that define the lifecycle contract being changed.
